news.title: Georgia music artist 'Lil Toonk' set for court hearing after murder arrest
news.summary: Georgia music artist Tavorian Lindsey, known as "Lil Toonk, is expected to appear before a Fulton County judge on Monday following his arrest on six counts of felony murder and other charges.

news.title: Sandy Springs shooting leaves 2 injured, including suspect who police say shot himself
news.summary: Two people were shot Saturday morning on Roswell Rd in Sandy Springs, as police investigate the circumstances surrounding the incident.

news.title: Driver wanted after hit-and-run crash in Loganville, police say
news.summary: A search is underway for a Jonesboro man facing multiple charges after a hit-and-run crash in Loganville on Saturday, according to police.

news.title: 2 sentenced in federal methamphetamine trafficking case
news.summary: Two Milledgeville residents have been sentenced to federal prison for their roles in a drug trafficking ring that brought methamphetamine across the state from Atlanta to Milledgeville.

2 killed after fire at southwest Atlanta home, authorities say
news.summary: A house fire in southwest Atlanta left two people dead early Sunday morning after heavy flames forced firefighters to briefly retreat from the home.

news.title: 1 injured after shooting in Forest Park, police say
news.summary: A 26-year-old man was injured after a shooting in Forest Park on Saturday afternoon, according to the Clayton County Police Department.
